Uses and Administration Pyrvinium embonate is an effective anthelmintic in the treatment of enterobiasis (p.136), but has generally been superseded by other drugs. Pyrvinium is given as the embonate but doses are described in terms of the base. Pyrvinium embonate 7.5 mg is equivalent to about 5 mg of pyrvinium. It has been given orally in a single dose equivalent to pyrvinium 5 mg/kg, repeated after 2 to 3 weeks. Preparations USP 31: Pyrvinium Pamoate Oral Suspension; Pyrvinium Pamoate Tablets.
